zh: 就在昨天，兰州举办了首届OPC技能交流大会。
en: Yesterday, Lanzhou hosted its first OPC Skills Exchange Conference.

zh: 如果是兰州本地的朋友，想学AI，
en: If you are in Lanzhou and want to learn AI,

zh: 想做点跟AI有关的事，网上的信息其实很多。
en: online information about working with AI is everywhere.

zh: 可真想参与进来，最容易卡在三个问题：
en: But three questions stop real participation:

zh: 去哪里实训，去哪里找同行，去哪里找创业支持。
en: where to train, find peers, and find startup support?

zh: 看到这场大会的现场内容，我感觉到一个很积极的变化。
en: After seeing the conference materials, I felt a very positive shift.

zh: 兰州的AI创业，正在从网上听概念，
en: AI entrepreneurship in Lanzhou is moving beyond online concepts,

zh: 慢慢变成了一件在本地可以找到入口的事。
en: toward access points people can find locally.

zh: 现在大家经常讨论，AI真正的大爆发到底开始了没有？
en: People often ask whether the real AI boom has begun.

zh: 有人看模型，有人看算力，
en: Some watch models and some compute,

zh: 也有人看全世界到底有多少人在用AI。
en: while others watch global AI adoption.

zh: 但对一个普通人来说，我更愿意看一件直接的事。
en: But for ordinary people, I look at something more direct.

zh: 你所在的城市，有没有地方让你真正学起来、动起手，
en: Does your city offer a place to learn and practice,

zh: 找到可以一起做事的人？
en: and meet people to work with?

zh: 这次大会，把三个入口摆得更清楚了。
en: This conference made three access points clearer.

zh: 第一个，是实训入口。
en: First: training.

zh: 太擎OPC实训基地在金城青年创业谷揭牌。
en: The Taiqing OPC Training Base was unveiled at Jincheng Youth Entrepreneurship Valley.

zh: 大会现场还安排了智能体的实操。
en: The conference also included hands-on AI agent practice.

zh: 参训人员跟着流程搭建起了自己的智能体。
en: Participants followed the process and built their own agents.

zh: 这件事最积极的地方，不是大家又听懂了多少概念。
en: The positive part is not how many more concepts people understood.

zh: 而是AI开始从台上的演讲，走到了参训者手里的电脑和手机上。
en: AI moved from stage talks into the computers and phones in participants’ hands.

zh: 一次实操，至少能让人先看见它到底怎么整理资料、
en: One practice session can show how it organizes information,

zh: 做内容、处理方案，自己动过手以后，再判断还缺什么。
en: creates content and handles plans before you judge what is missing.

zh: 这条路就是比只在网上围观清楚得多。
en: That path is much clearer than watching from the sidelines online.

zh: 第二个，是协作入口。
en: Second: collaboration.

zh: AI产学研联盟兰州分会也在金城青年创业谷揭牌。
en: The Lanzhou branch of the AI Industry-Academia-Research Alliance was also unveiled there.

zh: 大会邀请了本地科技企业分享创业经验。
en: Local technology companies shared their startup experience.

zh: 甘肃省广告协会还组织会员企业代表到场。
en: The Gansu Advertising Association also brought member-company representatives.

zh: 广告行业为什么会关注这件事情？
en: Why is the advertising industry paying attention?

zh: 因为文案、创意素材、方案整理、新媒体内容，
en: Copy, creative assets, plans, and new-media content

zh: 这些工作已经能和AI发生很具体的连接。
en: can now connect with AI in concrete ways.

zh: 我看到的未来方向很具体，AI不会只停留在科技公司。
en: The future direction I see is concrete: AI will not remain only in technology companies.

zh: 它会继续进入广告、设计、制造、农业，还有更多的本地企业。
en: It will reach advertising, design, manufacturing, agriculture, and more local businesses.

zh: 真正懂行业的人和懂AI的人，会有越来越多一起做事的机会。
en: Industry experts and AI practitioners will have more chances to work together.

zh: 第三个，是扶持入口。
en: Third: support.

zh: 会上还发布了“OPC创业直通车”专项扶持计划。
en: The conference also launched the OPC Startup Express support program.

zh: 它面向创业者、职场从业者和中小微企业。
en: It targets entrepreneurs, professionals, and small and medium-sized businesses.

zh: 内容包括政策扶持、技术赋能、实训指导和资源对接。
en: It covers policy, technology, training, and resource support.

zh: 扶持计划已经发布，但申请条件和后续的运行方式呢，
en: The plan has been announced, while application conditions and operating methods

zh: 马上也会提出一些细节。
en: should be detailed further soon.

zh: 我先把它看作入口，不提前把入口说成结果。
en: I treat it as an access point, not as a guaranteed result.

zh: 搭完一个智能体，也不等于已经拥有了一家真正能够经营的OPC。
en: Building one agent does not mean you already have a sustainable OPC business.

zh: 接下来要看的是公开的细则和真实的项目。
en: What matters next is the public detail and real projects.

zh: 但入口被摆在台面上，已经是一个值得关注的开始。
en: Putting the entry point on the table is already a start worth watching.

zh: 有实训的地方，有可以连接行业的组织，也有正在公布的创业支持。
en: There is training, industry connection, and startup support.

zh: 对兰州普通人来说，AI不再是北上广深发生的新闻。
en: For people in Lanzhou, AI is no longer just news from China’s largest cities.

zh: 你可以从本地开始寻找一个合适自己的位置。
en: You can start locally and find a position that fits you.

zh: 这三个入口，也让我重新理解了OPC。
en: These three entry points changed how I see OPC.

zh: 一人公司，不等于一个人关起门来什么都得扛。
en: A one-person company does not mean carrying everything alone.

zh: 组织越轻，越需要外面的实训、同行的协作和一些资源的连接。
en: Light organizations need outside training, peers, and resource connections.

zh: 刚开始，就先关注实训，把手动起来；
en: If you are starting, train and get hands-on.

zh: 有行业经验，就关注联盟和行业交流。
en: If you know an industry, follow alliances and industry exchanges.

zh: 看看自己的经验能和AI接在哪一步。
en: See where your experience can connect with AI.

zh: 已经有创业想法，就盯住扶持计划后面的公开细则，
en: If you have a startup idea, watch the public details,

zh: 再决定自己适不适合参与。
en: then decide whether it fits you.

zh: 我觉得未来很可能是，公司越来越轻，
en: Companies may get lighter,

zh: 一个人能调用的工具、伙伴和本地资源却会越来越多。
en: while one person can call on more tools, partners, and local resources.

zh: AI也会一点点地进入本地培训、行业协作、创业服务和日常工作。
en: AI will enter local training, collaboration, startup services, and daily work.

zh: 当这些入口出现在自己的城市里，普通人就不用一直站在远处看。
en: With local entry points, ordinary people need not watch from afar.

zh: 实训、协作、创业。
en: Training, collaboration, entrepreneurship.

zh: 这三个入口，你现在最需要哪一个？
en: Which of these three do you need most right now?

zh: 评论区告诉我。
en: Tell me in the comments.

zh: 后面我会继续看，兰州这些AI入口，
en: I will keep watching how Lanzhou’s AI entry points

zh: 怎么从一场大会慢慢变成大家真正能够参与的一个机会。
en: turn from one conference into opportunities people can truly join.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
